newsitem.title: INDIA: India Finance Ministry launches Internet home page.
newsitem.headline: India Finance Ministry launches Internet home page.

text.p: India's Finance Ministry launched a home page carrying official information and documents on the Internet information highway on Tuesday.
The home page will carry all important documents of the ministry including the annual budget papers and the Economic Survey, the ministry said in a statement.

The home page, launched by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram at a function, will also contain documents on all policy decisions, press statements and notifications of public importance, the statement said.
The site can be accessed on the Internet at the address: http://www.nic.in/finmin, the statement said.
The site contains electronic mail addresses of leading Finance Ministry officials.
